security.csp: default-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; script-src 'self'

bundle.shortDescription: A split-flap message board for your Mac, PC or Linux desktop
bundle.longDescription: Rattleboard is a split-flap message board for your desktop: a pop-up, a pinned widget or full screen. Compose messages and sequences, send them to your other boards, run a calm rotation of clocks, weather, countdowns and feeds, and let scripts post to its built-in API.
